# GitHub Copilot Custom Instructions

## Context
This repository contains the **Pedoman Penulisan Karya Ilmiah (PPKI) IPB University**. Copilot should always refer to the structured data in `data/structured/` when answering questions or generating text.

## Strict Rules
- **Margins**: Left 4cm, others 3cm.
- **Fonts**: Times New Roman 12pt.
- **Tone**: Formal, passive Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia).
- **Terminology**: Use "Prakata" and "Simpulan".
- **Citations**: IPB University Style (APA 7th based).

## Commands
- Search: `python scripts/search_ppki.py "<query>"`
